scripts.test: bun fetch:fixtures && bun run build && bun typecheck && bun test:parser && bun test:codegen && bun test:ast && bun test:analyzer && bun test:dialect && bun test:sourcemap && bun test:runtime
scripts.test:codegen: bun run --cwd npm/yuku-codegen build && zig build codegen-reference && bun test test/codegen
scripts.test:dialect: zig build wasm -Ddialect=src/parser/testing/dialect.zig --prefix zig-out/dialect && bun test test/dialect
scripts.build: zig build wasm && cp ./zig-out/bin/yuku.wasm ./npm/yuku-parser/ && bun gen:npm
scripts.gen:npm: zig build gen-token-types gen-parser-decoder gen-analyzer-decoder gen-walk-tables && cp ./zig-out/tokens.d.ts ./npm/yuku-types && cp ./zig-out/decode.js ./npm/yuku-parser && cp ./zig-out/decode-analyzer.js ./npm/yuku-analyzer/decode.js && cp ./zig-out/walk-tables.ts ./npm/yuku-ast/src/generated.ts && bun run --cwd npm/yuku-ast build && bun run --cwd npm/yuku-codegen build
